title: Lyra Platform Event Schema
description: Defines the event structure emitted by Lyra for audit trails, logging, and observability webhooks.

event_id.description: Unique UUID for the event instance.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was emitted.

payload.description: Event-specific key-value payload containing trace metadata.

actor.description: The entity that initiated the action.

x-intendedUse: Authoritative validation of observability events pushed to logging pipelines and webhooks.
